info.name: Get the list of object records and total records count for an object.

params.name: object_type
params.description: Object type for the records to retrieve. Must be a previously created custom object type. Contact as object type is not supported in this endpoint.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of records returned per page

params.name: page_num
params.description: Page number for pagination. It's used to fetch the object records on a provided page number. Must be a valid positive integer.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order, must be 'asc' or 'desc'. Default to 'desc' if not provided.

params.name: association
params.description: Whether to include associations, must be 'true' or 'false'. Default to 'false' if not provided.

items.docs:
<Note title="Enterprise access only">Custom objects are only available to Enterprise plans.
This feature is in beta. These are subject to change.</Note>
This API retrieves a list of object records along with their associated records and provides the total count of records for the specified object. **Note**: Contact as object type is not supported in this endpoint.

info.name: Delete multiple object records (up to 1000) asynchronously

params.name: object_type
params.description: Object type for the records to delete

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to delete multiple object records of the same object-type in one request.
The request is accepted and processed asynchronously. You can track the status of the deletion process using the returned **processId**.
